blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Humanoid robots are typically trained as solitary agents, leaving them unable to coordinate physically with human partners who naturally anticipate and adjust to one another. To bridge this gap, we present Social Humanoid, a hierarchical system that generates and executes socially responsive whole-body motion on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 conditioned on a human partner's motion. Its high-level policy performs flexible sequence modeling of human and humanoid motion through a shared tokenized representation, generating reactive humanoid motion and anticipating the partner's motion when they are occluded, while a low-level whole-body tracking controller executes the generated motion on the robot. To train the system, we introduce a two-phase adaptive retargeting procedure that retargets one interaction partner to the robot while morphing the other partner to preserve contact dynamics, reachability, and relative body scale. We apply this procedure across five motion-capture datasets to produce a new Human-Humanoid Interaction (HHI) benchmark of 260 hours of human-humanoid interactions. Our results demonstrate that Social Humanoid produces coordinated, human-aligned behavior across diverse interaction types in simulation and the real world. Project page: https://von31.github.io/social-humanoid/
blocks.zh: 人造机器人一般被训练为单独代理,使他们无法与自然预期并相互适应的人类伙伴进行身体协调. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出社会人性(Social Humanoid),一种分级系统,在29-DoF Unitree G1上,以人类伴侣的运动为条件,产生并执行具有社会响应性的全身运动. 其高端政策通过共同的标注表示来进行人类和人文运动的灵活序列建模,产生反应性人文运动,并在被占据时预测伴侣的运动,而低端的全身跟踪控制器则执行机器人上产生的运动. 为了训练系统,我们引入了一个两阶段的适应性重定向程序,将一个互动伙伴重新瞄准机器人,同时使另一个伙伴形态化,以保持接触动力,可达性和相对体积. 我们把这一程序应用于五个移动捕获数据集,以产生260小时人与人互动的新人类-人互动基准。 我们的结果显示,“社会人类”在模拟和现实世界中,在各种相互作用类型中产生协调、人与人结合的行为。 项目网页:https://von31.github.io/social-humanoid/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Human interaction is the art of attunement, a continuous interplay of perception, anticipation, and response that enables seamless coordination. Whether synchronizing a high-five or collaborating on a shared task, people adjust effortlessly through gaze, posture, and timing, without words. This ability is a hallmark of social intelligence [ 56 , 18 , 21 ] , allowing humans to simultaneously anticipate and align with others in real time. In contrast, existing works train humanoids as solitary agents, leaving them unable to perceive social cues or respond to the people around them.
As humanoids move out of labs and into homes, workplaces, and shared public spaces, they will need the same capacity to operate alongside and with people.
blocks.zh:
人类互动是调和的艺术,是感知、预期和反应的连续相互作用,能够无缝地协调。 无论是同步击掌还是合作完成共同的任务,人们都会通过视线,姿势,以及时间来不费力地调整,没有文字. 这种能力是社会智力[56,18,21]的标志,使人类能够同时实时预测和与他人配合. 相比之下,现有作品将人造人训练成单独代理,使他们无法感知社会提示或对周围的人做出反应.
随着人造人从实验室搬出并搬入家庭、工作场所和共用公共场所,他们将需要同样的能力来与人并肩行动。

blocks.en:
To address this, we formulate the problem of human-humanoid interaction, in which a humanoid must continuously generate and execute coordinated, socially responsive whole-body motion given observations of a human partner.
We present Social Humanoid, a hierarchical system with a high-level and a low-level policy. The high-level policy generates reactive humanoid motion from the observed partner’s motion and anticipates the partner’s motion, even when they are occluded or human input is missing, enabling continuous interaction. The low-level policy then executes the generated motion on a real Unitree G1 humanoid.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这一问题,我们提出了人与人之间相互作用的问题,在这个问题中,人与人之间必须不断产生和执行协调的、具有社会反应的全身运动,以观察人类伙伴。
我们介绍的是社会人文类,一种具有高级和低级政策的分级制度。 高级政策从被观察到的伴侣的动作中产生活性人体活性运动,并预期伴侣的动作,即使这些动作被占据或人类输入缺失,也能够持续地相互作用。 低级政策然后在真正的Unitree G1人相上执行所生成的运动.

blocks.en:
While recent advances in human motion generation [ 42 , 19 , 8 , 41 ] can synthesize realistic dyadic interactions offline, deploying this capability on physical humanoids introduces three challenges:
First, a data gap : human-human interaction is captured at scale, but no dataset captures natural human-humanoid interaction and naively retargeting each partner independently destroys the contact, reach, and spatial structure that defines the interaction.
Second, a representation gap : human and humanoid motion live in different spaces, which forces the generative model to learn the differences between the two embodiments instead of focusing on the interaction itself. This gap has been largely overlooked in prior work.
Third, a generation gap : a natural approach is to generate the interaction with a human motion model and retarget to humanoid through optimization, but optimization-based retargeting is designed for clean, offline data and is brittle to noisy, discontinuous partner observations. A socially responsive humanoid needs a feed-forward model to generate humanoid motion directly.
blocks.zh:
虽然最近在人类运动生成[42,19,8,41]方面的进步可以合成现实的线下二极体相互作用,但将这种能力部署在人体物理上带来了三个挑战:
首先,一个数据差距:人类与人类的相互作用在尺度上被捕获,但是没有数据集能够捕捉自然的人类与人类的相互作用,天真地重新瞄准每个伴侣独立地破坏决定相互作用的接触,接触,和空间结构.
第二,代表差距 : 人和人相体运动生活在不同的空间,这迫使基因模型去学习两个活体之间的差异,而不是专注于相互作用本身. 以前的工作在很大程度上忽略了这一差距。
第三,一代差距:一种自然的方法是产生与人类运动模型的相互作用,并通过优化重新瞄准人形,但基于优化的再定向是为清洁的离线数据而设计的,并且对吵闹的、不连续的伙伴观测十分灵活。 具有社会应变能力的人造物需要一种饲料前导模型来直接生成人造物运动.

blocks.en: Social Humanoid addresses these challenges with three contributions that build on one another. (i) For the data gap, we introduce a two-phase Adaptive-HHI Retargeting procedure that retargets one partner to the 29-DoF Unitree G1 and morphs the other’s body pose to preserve contact, reach, and relative scale. Applied to Chi3D [ 15 ] , Hi4D [ 62 ] , Harmony4D [ 33 ] , Inter-X [ 59 ] , and Embody3D [ 44 ] , it yields the HHI Benchmark, comprising 260 hours of dyadic and polyadic interactions paired with the G1. (ii) For the representation gap, our key insight is that a shared motion representation lets a single generative model reason jointly about both embodiments, which we instantiate with a shared-codebook VQ-VAE that tokenizes human and humanoid motion into a single discrete vocabulary. This vocabulary also supports real-time shadow teleoperation of the G1 without optimization-based retargeting (Sec. 5.2 ).. (iii) For the generation gap, our high-level policy is a Diffusion Forcing Transformer that autoregressively generates humanoid responses over this shared vocabulary; its diffusion-forcing objective is well-suited to imperfect, real-world input and supports fluid, long-horizon interaction. Paired with NVIDIA SONIC [ 39 ] as the low-level whole-body tracking controller, Social Humanoid demonstrates coordinated, interactive, and human-aligned behaviors in both simulation and real-world hardware experiments. Generation and execution run asynchronously, with a median end-to-end latency of 308 ms from camera frame to humanoid command.
blocks.zh: " 人类社会 " 组织以三项相辅相成的贡献来应对这些挑战。 (一) 对于数据差距,我们采用两个阶段的适应-HHI重定目标程序,将一个伙伴重新瞄准29-DoF Unitree G1,并改变另一个伙伴的身体形态,以保持接触、接触范围和相对规模。 它应用到Chi3D [15],Hi4D [62],和谐4D [33],Inter-X [59],和Embody3D [44] ,得出了HHI基准,由260小时的二元和多元相互作用组成,与G1对齐. blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Human Motion Generation. Large-scale motion datasets such as AMASS [ 40 ] have enabled major advances in generative human motion modeling. Early approaches relied on recurrent and convolutional architectures for motion prediction and synthesis [ 16 , 24 , 32 , 47 , 23 , 5 ] , followed by structured and probabilistic formulations for multimodal motion generation [ 2 , 65 , 70 ] . More recently, transformer-, VAE-, autoregressive-, and diffusion-based approaches have significantly improved long-horizon coherence, controllability, and diversity [ 12 , 22 , 1 , 29 , 67 , 68 ] .
blocks.zh: 人类运动一代. AMASS等大型运动数据集[40]使得基因人类运动模型化有了重大进步. 早期方法依赖反复和不断演化的结构来进行运动预测和合成[16、24、32、47、23、5],然后是多式联运生成的结构化和概率化配方[2、65、70]。 最近,变压器 -- -- 、VAE -- -- 、自相递回式和传播式办法大大地改善了长相的连贯性、可控制性和多样性[12、22、1、29、67、68]。

blocks.en: Humanoid Motion Generation. Parallel progress in humanoid motion generation has combined reinforcement learning [ 64 , 63 ] , imitation learning and retargeting [ 10 , 38 , 66 ] , and generative motion priors [ 11 , 69 , 7 , 48 , 31 ] to produce increasingly natural humanoid behaviors. Recent systems further leverage monocular video reconstruction and diffusion-based policies for contextual and goal-aware control [ 3 , 35 ] , while optimization-based methods such as OmniRetarget [ 60 ] improve geometric and kinematic consistency during motion transfer. However, these approaches primarily focus on single-agent motion generation or independently retargeted trajectories, often failing to preserve the contact, reachability, and relative geometry required for socially coordinated human-humanoid interaction. In contrast, our interaction-aware adaptive retargeting sequentially optimizes humanoid retargeting and partner co-morphing to preserve socially meaningful interaction structure.
blocks.zh: 人气动能生成. 人形运动生成的平行进展结合了强化学习[64,63],模仿学习并重新瞄准[10,38,66],以及基因运动前身[11,69,7,48,31],产生出越来越自然的人形行为. 最近的系统进一步利用以单相机的视频重建和传播为基础的政策来进行上下文和目标感知控制[3,35],而以优化为基础的方法,如OmniReocter[60]在运动转移期间改善几何和运动一致性. 然而,这些方法主要侧重于单剂活性运动产生或独立地重定向的轨迹,往往未能保持社会协调的人类-人间相互作用所需的接触,可达到性和相对几何. 相形之下,我们互动意识的适应性再定向顺序优化了人造物的再定向和伙伴同形结构,以保持具有社会意义的互动结构。

blocks.en: Dyadic Interaction and Human Motion Anticipation. Humans coordinate interactions by continuously anticipating others’ intentions through posture, timing, gaze, and motion cues [ 21 , 17 , 50 ] . Motivated by this, recent work has explored dyadic human interaction [ 45 , 14 , 58 , 49 , 28 , 30 , 8 , 55 , 20 ] , enabling realistic, coordinated behaviors between human partners. Complementary efforts study socially expressive and interaction-aware motion generation, including dance, social affordances, and language-conditioned interaction [ 36 , 52 , 42 , 51 , 13 ] . While these methods produce compelling human-human interactions, they do not address the embodiment mismatch, streaming perception, and control constraints required for deployment on physical humanoids.

Dyadic Interactive and Human Motion Exception. 人类通过姿势、时间、目光和动作提示[21、17、50]不断预测他人的意图来协调互动。 为此,最近的工作探索了人与人之间的互动[45、14、58、49、28、30、8、55、20],使人类伙伴之间能够采取现实而协调的行为。 辅助努力研究社会表达和互动意识运动生成,包括舞蹈、社会负担和语言条件互动[36、52、42、51、13]。 虽然这些方法产生了令人信服的人与人之间的相互作用,但它们并没有解决表征不匹配、流出感知和控制在人体上部署所需的限制。

blocks.en: Human-Humanoid Interaction and Embodied Control. Prior work on human-humanoid interaction has explored physical assistance and contact-rich behaviors such as standing support and hugging [ 34 , 6 ] , as well as compliant and safe humanoid control for close-proximity interaction [ 43 , 37 ] . Anticipating human intentions or trajectories has also been studied for cooperative robotics [ 27 ] , typically as auxiliary modules for timing or safety rather than as part of motion generation itself. Other recent approaches generate humanoid motion from high-level textual descriptions, including social interaction prompts [ 31 ] . Hierarchical control frameworks further demonstrate the benefits of decomposing high-level motion planning and low-level motor execution for robust robot behavior [ 4 ] . In contrast to prior work, Social Humanoid unifies predictive human motion understanding, cross-embodiment generative modeling, and embodied humanoid control into a single framework for socially coordinated human-humanoid interaction.
blocks.zh: 人与人之间的相互作用和健全的控制。 此前关于人与人之间相互作用的工作探索了物理辅助和接触丰富的行为,如站立支持和拥抱[34,6],以及对近亲相互作用的遵守和安全的人体活性控制[43,37]. 也曾为合作机器人研究过人类意向或轨迹[27],通常作为定时或安全性的辅助模块,而不是运动生成本身的一部分. 最近的其他方法从高级文字描述中产生人文运动,包括社会互动提示[31]. 分级控制框架进一步证明了分解高层次运动规划和低层次运动执行对于强力机器人行为的好处 [4]. 与以前的工作不同,社会人造人统一了对人类运动的预测性理解,交叉表现了基因模型,并将人造人控制纳入社会协调人与人相互作用的单一框架。

blocks.en: 3 Human-Humanoid Interaction Generative Modeling
blocks.zh: 3 人与人之间的相互作用

blocks.en: Enabling socially coordinated human-humanoid interaction requires not only realistic motion synthesis, but also the ability to react continuously to a human partner. We therefore train a generative model on human-humanoid interaction trajectories, enabling fast, reactive motion generation at inference time. The core of our Social Humanoid system is a high-level policy that predicts humanoid kinematic motion from observed human motion, which are subsequently executed by a low-level tracking policy; see Fig. 2 for an overview of the system. The construction of the interaction dataset via interaction-aware retargeting is described in Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 促成社会协调的人类与人之间的相互作用,不仅需要现实的运动合成,而且需要对人类伙伴的持续反应能力。 因此,我们在人与人之间的相互作用轨迹上培养出基因模型,从而能够在推论时迅速、被动地产生运动。 我们的"社会人文"系统的核心是高层次的政策,从被观察到的人类运动中预测出人文动能运动,随后通过低层次的跟踪政策执行;系统概况参见图2. 第4节介绍了通过互动意识重新确定目标构建互动数据集的情况。

blocks.en: 3.1 Shared-Codebook VQ-VAE
blocks.zh: 3.1 共用守则VQ-VAE

blocks.en: Figure 3: Shared-Codebook VQ-VAE . Human and humanoid motion sequences are independently encoded into latent features and mapped to a shared vector-quantized codebook that learns a common motion vocabulary across embodiments. Embodiment-specific decoders reconstruct the respective motions, enabling aligned, transferable motion representations between humans and humanoids.
blocks.zh: 图3:共用守则VQ-VAE 人类和人文运动序列被独立地编码为潜在的特征并被映射到一个共享的矢量化的编码本上,该编码本学习出一个跨越活体的共同运动词汇. 嵌入特异性解码器重建了相应的运动,使得人与人之间的运动表现能够一致,可转移.

blocks.en: Generating motion for Social Humanoids requires efficient, streaming-based generation, which motivates us to compactly tokenize high-dimensional human and humanoid motion trajectories. Recognizing that human and humanoid motions may share a similar latent structure, we encode both trajectories into a unified discrete vocabulary using a shared-codebook VQ-VAE (Fig. 3 ). Crucially, this shared representation simplifies the training of the subsequent diffusion model (see Sec. 5 ), as the primary motion spaces of the human partner and the humanoid are inherently heterogeneous.
blocks.zh: 创造社会人造物的运动需要高效的、以流为主的一代,这促使我们把高维人和人造物的运动轨迹紧凑地表示出来。 认识到人类和人文运动可能具有类似的潜伏结构,我们利用共用编码本VQ-VAE(图3)将两个轨迹编码成一个统一的离散词汇。 关键的是,这种共同的表示简化了随后的传播模型(见Sec. 5)的训练,因为人类伴侣和人体的主要运动空间本质上是不同的.

blocks.en: To model human–humanoid interaction in the shared token space introduced above, we use a flexible sequence model based on Diffusion Forcing Transformer (DFoT) [ 9 , 54 ] . DFoT is a conditional generative model that integrates the denoising process of DDPMs [ 26 ] with the temporal strengths of transformers [ 57 ] . A core advantage of this design is its ability to learn non-Markovian temporal dependencies across entire sequences using adaptive noise levels.
blocks.zh: 为了模拟人类与人类在上文介绍的共享符号空间中的相互作用,我们使用基于分化活性变形器(DFoT)[9,54]的灵活序列模型. DFoT是一种有条件的基因模型,将DDPMS的去诺化过程[26]与变压器的时间强度[57]相融合. 这种设计的一个核心优势是它能够利用适应性噪声水平在整个序列中学习非马尔可夫时间依赖性.

blocks.en: 3.3 End-to-End Deployment

blocks.en: We deploy Social Humanoid on a Unitree G1 using the perception, generation, and control pipeline in Fig. 2 , with most computation offboard. A tripod-mounted ZED 2i stereo camera observes the human partner. We estimate the partner’s SMPL pose using Fast SAM 3D Body [ 61 ] and recover metric root position from stereo depth. AprilTags and onboard odometry localize the humanoid in the same gravity-aligned frame. We encode both agents’ states into the shared interaction representation for DFoT, which autoregressively generates humanoid motion conditioned on observed partner motion and recent humanoid history using 30-step DDIM sampling. NVIDIA SONIC [ 39 ] tracks the decoded motion at 50 Hz. Generation and execution run asynchronously, with 308 ms median latency from camera frame to executed humanoid command. See Appendix A.6 for details.

blocks.en: 4 Humanoid-Human Interaction Data Generation
blocks.zh: 4 人类-人类相互作用数据生成

blocks.en: Social humanoid development is bottlenecked by a lack of human-humanoid interaction datasets. While human-human data is abundant, direct kinematic retargeting fails due to morphology gaps. To this end, we propose an interaction-preserving retargeting method maintaining contact locations, relative poses, and inter-person geometry.
blocks.zh: 由于缺乏人与人之间的相互作用数据集,社会人文学科的发展受到阻碍。 虽然人类-人类数据丰富,但由于形态差距,直接动能重定向失败. 为此,我们提出一种互动保留重定向方法,保持接触位置,相对姿势和人际几何.

blocks.en: Building on OmniRetarget [ 60 ] ’s Sequential Quadratic Programming (SQP) and interaction-mesh formulation [ 25 ] , we address a central challenge of dyadic retargeting: bridging the morphology gap without distorting the interaction. Retargeting the humanoid independently can place interaction points out of reach, while uniformly rescaling the pair would make the human partner unrealistically small, creating a mismatch between the people the humanoid interacts with at deployment. We use a two-pass pipeline that retargets the ego, then adapts the partner’s pose—not its scale—to the retargeted humanoid (Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 在OmniRetarge [60] 的相继四方式编程(SQP)和交互-mesh 配制[25]的基础上,我们应对了分级重定向的中心挑战:弥合形态上的差距而不会扭曲交互. 独立地重新瞄准人造物可以使相互作用点无法达到,而统一调整成对则会使人的伴侣不切实际地小,造成人造物在部署时相互作用的人之间的不匹配. 我们使用双通管,重新瞄准自我,然后使伙伴的姿势——而不是其规模——适应被重新瞄准的人体(图4)。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Adaptive-HHI Retargeting. Our retargeting pipeline starts from two ground truth humans. In the first pass, we retarget the ego human (orange) to the humanoid using a contact-adaptive weight matrix to encourage body pose in regions close to the physical interaction to be preserved. In a second pass, we co-morph the partner’s pose towards more plausible interaction via a contact-gated morphing strategy driven by the amount of physical contact present in the interaction.
blocks.zh: 图4:适应性HHI 重新瞄准目标 我们重新瞄准的管道 从两个地面真理人类开始 第一次通过,我们利用接触-适应性重量矩阵,将自我人类(橙色)重新定位为人形,鼓励身体在接近要保存的物理相互作用的区域出场. 在第二次通过中,我们通过一种由互动中实际接触量所驱动的接触定型的形态策略,共同改变伙伴的姿势,使互动更加合理。

blocks.en: Pass I: Ego-to-humanoid Retargeting. Given an interaction between a source human (the ego) and a partner, this pass retargets the ego to the humanoid, leaving the partner unchanged. Following OmniRetarget [ 25 , 60 ] , we solve a per-frame SQP over the humanoid configuration that preserves the local shape of the ego’s interaction mesh, with Laplacian coordinates scaled to humanoid height, and keeps the humanoid’s wrist and elbow distances to the partner equal to the ego’s. Temporal smoothness and posture regularization complete the objective, subject to joint limits and foot-sticking constraints. Both the shape and distance terms emphasize the wrists, where most contact occurs. The full objective is given in Appendix A.3.1 and our contact-aware grounding in Appendix A.3.3 .
blocks.zh: 传一:从人到人 重新瞄准目标 鉴于一个源性人类(自负)和伴侣之间的相互作用,这个通过将自负重新瞄准了人形,使伴侣不变. 在OmniRetarget [25,60] 之后,我们解决了一个每帧 SQP 覆盖人类的构型,这个构型保留了自我互动网的局部外形,拉普拉西安坐标被缩放到人类的高度,并将人类的手腕和肘部距离维持在与自我相等的伴侣身上. 时间平稳和姿势正规化完成目标,但需受共同限制和脚踏实地的限制. 外形和相距术语都强调手腕,其中多有接触. 全部目标载于附录A.3.1,我们的联系意识载于附录A.3.3。

blocks.en:
Pass II: Partner Co-Morphing. Pass I leaves the human partner unchanged, causing contact misalignment because the G1 is substantially shorter than the source human. For example, the partner’s hands may reach above the humanoid’s shoulders during hugs. Pass II adapts the partner’s pose to the retargeted humanoid.
For all contacts, we apply arm-chain IK over the partner’s shoulder, elbow, and wrist during frames with humanoid arm contact, preserving the source ego–partner wrist and elbow offsets relative to the retargeted humanoid while respecting anatomical joint limits. For high-contact segments, we additionally solve a body-pose QP over key vertex clusters (wrists, chest, and neck), which additionally adjusts the partner’s hips, spine, and knees. This restores contact fidelity across large morphology gaps while preserving realistic human proportions.
blocks.zh:
传 二:搭档同音. 过 我让人类伴侣不变 造成接触错位 因为G1比源头人类短得多 例如,伴侣的双手在拥抱时会伸到人肩上。 Pass II使伴侣的姿势适应被重新瞄准的人体.
在所有接触中,我们用手臂链IK在伴侣的肩部、肘部和手腕上与人造手臂接触,保持源自负 — — 伴侣手腕和肘部在尊重解剖连接限制的同时抵消被重新瞄准的人体。 对于高接触区段,我们额外在关键顶点群(腕部、胸部和颈部)上解决了身体的QP,这将进一步调整伴侣的臀部、脊椎和膝盖。 这在保持现实的人类比例的同时,恢复了跨越大形态间隙的接触忠心.

blocks.en: We retarget each clip twice, swapping the ego and partner, so both interaction roles are represented in the dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们将每个片段重定向两次,互换自我和伴侣,因此两个互动角色都体现在数据集中.

blocks.en: Metrics . We evaluate three tasks. For generative modeling, given the past and current human motion and the past humanoid motion, the high-level policy predicts the humanoid’s reactive motion, which we compare against the retargeted HHI data in terms of positional accuracy, motion dynamics, physical realism, and interaction coordination. For retargeting, we evaluate how faithfully a human–human interaction is transferred to the humanoid. Finally, we evaluate whether the low-level policy can execute the generated motions in simulation and on the real humanoid.

blocks.en:
Baselines .

Evaluating socially responsive humanoid interaction is challenging because existing methods either synthesize human-human interactions offline or generate isolated humanoid behaviors without addressing executable cross-embodiment interaction generation. We therefore compare against retrieval-based Nearest Neighbor (NN) and Random Sample (RS), which measure dataset memorization and distributional coverage, and against Ready-to-React (R2R) [ 8 ] , a reaction policy for two-character interaction generation. NN retrieves the training window with the lowest L2 distance between normalized partner joint positions in the canonical frame, and RS samples a window uniformly at random.

基线

评价具有社会应变性的人造生物相互作用具有挑战性,因为现有方法要么将人与人之间的相互作用综合起来,要么产生孤立的人造生物行为,而不处理可执行的交叉表现相互作用。 因此,我们比较了基于检索的近邻(NN)和随机样本(RS),后者衡量数据集的计量和分布覆盖范围,比较了Ready-to-React(R2R)[8],即一种双特征交互生成的反应政策. NN取回了训练窗口,在Cononical框架的正常伙伴联合位置之间L2距离最小,RS随机统一取出一个窗口.

blocks.en: High-level Policy Motion Quality. Table 1 evaluates the generative modeling capability of the high-level policy. Our method achieves the lowest positional error with a W-MPJPE of 0.128, substantially outperforming R2R (0.545), NN (1.099), and RS (1.100), and the best motion dynamics with an MPJVE of 0.007, indicating smoother, more temporally coherent motion. NN achieves the best FD (0.053 vs. our 0.118), and NN and RS have lower foot skating (FS), since retrieval replays recorded training motions with physically valid foot contacts. Despite this limitation, the proposed approach still produces coherent full-body motions with substantially improved interaction.

blocks.en: Sim and Real Humanoid Evaluation. Our retargeting pipeline and high-level policy do not model physics explicitly, so we test whether the generated humanoid motions are physically feasible by executing them with the low-level policy, both in simulation and on the real G1. In simulation, a rollout succeeds if the low-level policy tracks the generated motion without falling or other unsafe behavior; we evaluate 30 generated motions per scenario. On the real humanoid, a trial succeeds if the G1 executes the appropriate reaction and completes the interaction without falling or operator intervention; we run 30 trials per scenario across 4 participants. As Table 4 shows, the low-level policy reproduces nearly all generated motions in simulation (90–100% per scenario), and on the real G1 (Fig. 6 ) success matches simulation in every scenario.

blocks.en: 5.2 Shadow Teleoperation
blocks.zh: 5.2 影子电信业务

blocks.en: Beyond interaction generation, the shared-codebook VQ-VAE supports shadow teleoperation, in which the humanoid reproduces the whole-body motion of a human operator. As in cross-embodiment translation (Appendix A.4.2 ), we encode the operator’s motion with the human encoder E h E_{h} , quantize it against the shared codebook 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , and decode the resulting tokens with the humanoid decoder D r D_{r} . No humanoid motion is used as input, and no optimization-based retargeting is run.
blocks.zh: 除了交互生成外,共享编码本VQ-VAE支持影子电传操作,其中人形复制了人类操作员的全身运动. 如交叉化译(Appendix A.4.2), 我们用人类编码器Eh E_{h}编码操作员的动作, 不使用人文运动作为输入,也不运行基于优化的再定向.

blocks.en: Role of the shared codebook. Shadow teleoperation relies on human and humanoid poses mapping to the same codes, which is enforced by the alignment terms ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} and ℒ agree \mathcal{L}_{\text{agree}} in Eq. 3 . blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present Social Humanoid, a system for generating and executing socially responsive whole-body motion on a Unitree G1 conditioned on a human partner. It combines a two-phase Adaptive-HHI Retargeting procedure that produces paired human–humanoid data while preserving contact and scale, a shared-codebook VQ-VAE that maps both embodiments into a single discrete latent space, which also enables real-time shadow teleoperation, and a Diffusion Forcing Transformer that generates humanoid responses in this space, executed on the robot via SONIC. Together with the 260-hour HHI Benchmark, we show in simulation and on the real G1 that the system produces coordinated, human-aligned responses across a range of interaction types. We will release our data and code to support further work toward humanoids that coordinate physically with people.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍社会人性,这是一个以人类伴侣为条件的Unitree G1上产生和执行社会反应全体运动的系统。 它结合了两个阶段的适应-HHI重定向程序,在保持接触和规模的同时生成人-人配对数据,一个共享编码本VQ-VAE,将浮出物映射到单一的离散潜在空间,这也能够进行实时的影子远程操作,以及一个通过SONIC在机器人上执行的传播强化变形器,生成在这个空间中的人配对反应。 连同260小时的HHI基准,我们在模拟和真正的G1中显示,该系统在一系列互动类型中产生协调的、人与人相适应的反应。 我们将公布我们的数据和代码,以支持进一步开展与人进行实际协调的人类类类的工作。

blocks.en: Limitations and Future Work . First, we do not model hand articulation, facial expressions, or object pose, limiting dexterous, expressive, and object-centric interactions. Extending the shared codebook to fine-grained hand motion is a natural next step, while object interaction will likely require additional representation design. Second, we rely on SONIC and off-the-shelf human pose estimation, and inherit their failure modes in real-world deployment. Our system also tracks kinematic trajectories without modeling interaction forces, human comfort, or safety constraints during close contact, so safe deployment in unconstrained environments will require additional safety policies. Third, trackability and trial success measure execution, not social interaction quality; an HRI study is needed to assess the timeliness, naturalness, safety, and appropriateness of the humanoid’s responses. Fourth, we focus on dyadic human–humanoid interaction; extending to multiple humans, robots, or heterogeneous agents is an important direction for future work. Finally, when interacting with the robot, the lack of facial expressions or eye contact makes its behavior difficult to interpret, leading to awkward social interactions. An interesting direction for future work would be to enable more legible social interactions through facial expressions and eye contact.
blocks.zh: 限制和未来的工作 首先,我们不模拟手语表达,面部表情,或物体姿势,限制自相能动,表达力,和以物体为中心的相互作用. 将共享的代码本扩展为精细的手动是自然的下一步,而物体交互则可能需要额外的表示设计. 其次,我们依靠SONIC和现成的人类的姿势估计,在现实世界的部署中继承他们的失败模式. 我们的系统还跟踪运动轨迹,没有模拟互动力量,人间舒适,或密切接触时的安全限制,因此在不受约束的环境中安全部署需要额外的安全政策. 第三,可追踪性和试验成功度衡量执行,而不是衡量社会互动的质量;需要开展一项人权研究,以评估人造物反应的及时性、自然性、安全和适当性。 第四,我们注重人类与人类的相互作用;延伸到人类、机器人或多种物剂是未来工作的一个重要方向。 最后,在与机器人互动时,缺乏面部表情或眼睛接触使其行为难以被解释,导致尴尬的社会互动. 未来工作的一个令人感兴趣的方向是通过面部表情和眼睛接触,使社会互动更加明显。

blocks.en: In this section, we compare Adaptive-HHI to existing retargeting methods and provide additional implementation details and hyperparameter configurations for our retargeting pipeline.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们比较了适应-HHI与现有重新确定目标的方法,并为我们的重新确定目标管道提供了额外的实施细节和超参数配置.

blocks.en: Table A.2 compares Adaptive-HHI to prior retargeting methods along four axes: hard kinematic feasibility, preservation of inter-agent interaction, partner co-morphing, and adaptive contact handling. Interaction meshes were introduced for close-interaction character animation [ 25 ] and later adapted to biped humanoids [ 46 ] , where Laplacian deformation preserves spatial relationships under hard joint constraints, but only for the robot’s own body parts; the demonstrated interactions are self-contacts, and no human partner enters the optimization. PHC [ 38 ] imitates single-agent motion through a simulated physics policy, so feasibility is implicit and retargeted references can still exhibit motion artifacts. GMR [ 66 ] solves per-frame IK with joint and velocity limits, but its soft keypoint-matching objectives admit foot skating and penetration, and it has no notion of a partner. VideoMimic [ 3 ] adds scene context but handles collision and contact through soft penalties that compete with its matching costs. OmniRetarget [ 60 ] formulates retargeting as an interaction-mesh-regularized SOCP with hard constraints and preserves robot–object–terrain relationships, yet the surrounding scene is a fixed input to the solve, not an optimization variable. This is the core limitation for human–humanoid interaction: when the partner cannot adapt, the robot must absorb the entire embodiment gap, and the interaction breaks. Adaptive-HHI keeps OmniRetarget’s SOCP base and adds (i) partner co-morphing, adapting the partner’s arm configuration to the retargeted humanoid on contact frames so the dyad deforms together, and (ii) wrist- and elbow-distance preservation with wrist-boosted Laplacian weights that concentrate on interaction-critical regions while preserving human-scale structure elsewhere. Adaptive-HHI is the only method that satisfies all four criteria for dyadic human–humanoid interaction.

blocks.en: A.3.3 Contact-Aware Grounding
blocks.zh: A.3.3 了解联系的地面

blocks.en: We observed that pinning the feet to the floor on every frame fails during dynamic maneuvers such as high kicks and vertical jumps, and that the Laplacian term does not constrain global vertical positioning. We resolve this by introducing contact-aware grounding via three complementary terms: (1) velocity-based foot sticking , inherited from OmniRetarget , holds a foot’s horizontal position fixed only during stance intervals estimated from toe velocity; (2) per-frame ground shifting applies a smoothed correction to the robot base height, aligning with the floor during stance and tracking the source sole height during airborne phases, which we detect as runs of 3–30 frames with the sole more than 4 cm above a rolling-minimum floor estimate; and (3) ankle posture priors combine foot-keypoint downweighting with a diagonal ankle-pitch prior to suppress toe-down artifacts arising from human–humanoid foot mismatches.

blocks.en: Table A.5 ablates the two alignment losses used to build the shared human (H) and robot (R) codebook. Without alignment, the codebook reconstructs each embodiment well but translates poorly across them: H → \to R and R → \to H FD are 0.206 and 0.157, and no paired frames share a code. Adding both alignment losses reduces translation FD by more than an order of magnitude (to 0.0028 and 0.0044), lowers cross-embodiment reconstruction error (H → \to R from 12.52 to 2.79 cm and R → \to H from 12.95 to 3.71 cm), and raises code agreement from 0 to 0.78, while self-reconstruction slightly improves (H 3.67 → \to 3.56 cm, R 2.81 → \to 2.61 cm). blocks.en: To translate a human motion into humanoid motion, we encode it with the human encoder E h \mathrm{E}_{h} , quantize it against the shared codebook 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , and decode the resulting tokens with the humanoid decoder D r \mathrm{D}_{r} . No humanoid motion is used at inference, and no optimization-based retargeting is run. Translation is therefore a single feed-forward pass through the tokenizer. We evaluate it on held-out paired clips from the HHI benchmark, where the retargeted humanoid motion serves as ground truth for the translated output.
blocks.zh: 为了将人类运动转换为人相动,我们用人类编码器Eh\mathrm{E}_{h}编码,根据共享的编码本C\mathcal{C}对它进行定量,并用人相动解码器D r\mathrm{D}_{r}来解码产生的符号. 推论中不使用人相动,也不进行以优化为基础的再定向. 因此,翻译是单一的向导通过标致器. 我们用HHI基准的被搁置的配对片段来评价它,在那里,重新定向的人体活性运动是翻译输出的地盘真理.

blocks.en: Qualitative results . Figure A.1 shows two translated sequences. The top rows of each example show the human input (red) and the translated humanoid motion (purple) in simulation. The bottom rows show the same motion tracked on the physical G1 by SONIC. In the first example (a standing, reaching gesture), the translated humanoid reproduces the arm extension and the timing of the reach. In the second example (a crouch), the humanoid matches the overall posture and descent to the floor. In both cases the output stays within the G1’s joint limits and proportions, so the motion is directly trackable on hardware. Because the human and humanoid have very different limb lengths and degrees of freedom, the translation does not copy joint angles one-to-one. It reproduces the pose through the humanoid’s own kinematics.

blocks.en: Quantitative results . Table A.5 reports translation quality alongside self-reconstruction. With both alignment losses, H→R translation reaches an FD of 0.0028 and a root-relative MPJPE of 2.79 cm. This is close to the humanoid’s own self-reconstruction error (2.61 cm) and is lower than the human’s self-reconstruction error (3.56 cm). This shows that sharing a codebook alone does not produce a transferable vocabulary, and that the alignment terms are what make the codes consistent across embodiments. Code agreement between paired human and humanoid frames rises from 0.00 to 0.78 with both losses.

blocks.en: We train the shared-codebook VQ-VAE and DFoT models using the AdamW optimizer with an initial learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , a weight decay of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , and a mini-batch size of 256. The learning rate is cosine-decayed to zero over the course of training. Both the Shared-Codebook VQ-VAE and DFoT architectures utilize GELU activations and LayerNorm layers in their feed-forward blocks, and the DFoT model relies on a standard post-norm Transformer encoder architecture.

blocks.en: For the DFoT, we adopt a discrete diffusion formulation with an x 0 x_{0} -prediction parameterization. During training, we sample a diffusion timestep t ∈ { 1 , … , 1000 } t\in\{1,\dots,1000\} independently for each agent token to prevent architectural shortcutting, training the network to reconstruct the corresponding clean motion token x 0 x_{0} . At inference time, we employ deterministic DDIM sampling over 30 steps. Unless otherwise stated, each VQ-VAE model is trained for 100,000 steps, and each DFoT model is trained for 300,000 steps. Final checkpoints are selected based on the lowest validation loss.

blocks.en: Given per-frame RGB+D, we want to estimate the human’s SMPL pose and full SE(3) pelvis pose in a gravity-aligned, floor-origin camera frame C gcam C_{\text{gcam}} . We detect humans with YOLOv11 and pass each detection to Fast Sam 3D Body (FS3DB) [ 61 ] , which consists of an optimized MHR head and an MHR-to-SMPL regressor. Because the regressor is not trained to preserve global orientation, we recover orientation by using the Kabsch algorithm between corresponding regressed SMPL vertices and MHR vertices in the camera frame. To recover translation, we query a depth patch at selected vertices on the torso to get estimates for the pelvis depth. blocks.en: A.6.4 System Architecture
blocks.zh: A.6.4 系统架构

blocks.en: A laptop connected to the ZED 2i and the Unitree G1 performs time synchronization and publishes the RGB+D images and the robot estimation plus proprioception as a bundle at 15 Hz. Due to FS3DB’s compute requirements, we connect the laptop to a remote server using WiFi. We JPEG-compress the RGB stream and apply Zstd compression on the depth stream to maximize streaming rate. We run two instances of FS3DB with a global estimation coordinator at 15 Hz to tolerate variations in GPU load. The coordinator bundles the human and robot estimates and sends them to the high-level policy, which interpolates the incoming data to 30 Hz, performs inference, and emits chunks of 30 Hz robot motions at 7.5 Hz. Finally, SONIC interpolates the motions to 50 Hz and tracks them by providing desired DoF angles for a PD controller. We run inference on 2x NVIDIA 4090 GPUs for global human estimation, 1x NVIDIA 4090 GPU for the high-level policy, and 1x NVIDIA 4060 Mobile GPU for the low-level policy.
blocks.zh: 与ZED 2i和Unitree G1相接的笔记本电脑进行时间同步,并发布RGB+D图像和机器人估计外加自负作为捆绑在15赫兹. 由于FS3DB的计算要求,我们用WiFi将笔记本电脑连接到远程服务器上. We JPEG-compress the RGB stream,并在深度流上应用Zstd压缩来使流速最大化. 我们运行两个FS3DB的例子,一个全球估计协调员在15赫兹,以容忍GPU负载的变化. 协调员将人和机器人的估算数据捆绑起来,送到高级政策中,高级政策将输入的数据插入30赫兹,进行推论,并在7.5赫兹发出30赫兹机器人运动的块. 最后,SONIC将运动插入50赫兹,并通过为PD控制器提供所期望的DoF角度来跟踪. 我们推论2xNVIDIA 4090GPU用于全球人类估计,1xNVIDIA 4090GPU用于高级政策,1x NVIDIA 4060 Mobile GPU 低级政策.

blocks.en: We support two optional improvements upon the existing system which tradeoff latency to improve motion generation quality and stability. After DFoT inference, we delay the emission of robot motion chunks by 1 chunk to improve decoded motion continuity. For robustness against deviations in network latency and other sources of variation, SONIC maintains a buffer of previous motion and delays execution by 100 ms.

blocks.en: A.6.5 Latency Experiments
blocks.zh: A.6.5 延迟试验

blocks.en: We evaluate the end-to-end latency of our pipeline. In Table A.7 , we report the 50 and 95-percentile latencies ( n = 200 n=200 ), splitting the evaluation by stage. Stage 1: perception , which includes (i) fetch : retrieving the RGB+D image from the camera, (ii) sync : synchronization with robot estimation and construction of bundle, (iii) wire : network and blocking on input on the server-side, (iv) JPEG+zstd : compression encoding and decoding. Stage 2: human estimation, which bundles distributed coordination, FS3DB inference, and global estimation. Stage 3: high-level policy, which includes (i) interpolate : interpolation of SMPL from 15 → \to 30 Hz, (ii) VQ-VAE : encoding and decoding, (iii) DFoT : DFoT inference, (iv) postproc (optional): buffered decoding to improve motion continuity. Stage 4: low-level policy, which includes (i) SONIC : construction of observations, policy inference, sending commands to G1, (ii) wire : network transport back to laptop, (iii) wire buffer (optional): execution delay to improve tolerance to variation. We highlight optional components which tradeoff motion generation quality for latency. In reactive regimes, we achieve a median latency of 308ms.

blocks.en: A.6.6 System Safety
blocks.zh: A.6.6 系统安全

blocks.en: We validate safety progressively, from simulation to a gantry-supported robot to gantryless deployment. SONIC holds a standing pose until a dedicated operator, separate from the person interacting with the robot, engages it, and then smoothly executes high-level policy (HLP) frames. We clamp the desired yaw change to 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} /s. SONIC smoothly returns to standing if consecutive HLP predictions differ by more than 0.7 ​ rad 0.7\,\text{rad} , or if the operator judges the behavior unsafe. Across five 60 s rollouts, we observed no unsafe generated behavior. Note that the low-level policy is neither force-adaptive nor force-compliant, so physical contact is not actively regulated.
